questions.q: A die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 2? (give the fraction)
A die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting a prime number (2, 3 or 5)? (give the fraction)
Two coins are tossed together. What is the probability of getting exactly one head? (give the fraction)
2 fair coins are tossed together. What is the total number of possible outcomes?
Two dice are rolled together. How many outcomes are in the sample space?

solution_steps.action: divide favourable outcomes by total outcomes
solution_steps.explain: divide favourable outcomes by total outcomes: p = 1 / 6 gives 0.166667
